title: TfL takes Oyster photocard website offline after attackers compromise customer accounts
summary: Attackers compromised customer accounts on TfL's Oyster photocard website, potentially affecting 265,000 customers.

items.title: TfL takes Oyster photocard website offline after attackers compromise customer accounts
